about: Stories that ship with VidGen. One has its first episode written; the others are premises for Claude to write from.

stories.name: The knock
stories.premise: At 3 a.m. something knocks on your bedroom window. You live on the fourth floor. Whatever it is can copy the voices of people you love, and it wants to be let in.

episode.title: The knock
episode.question: Do you open the door, or hide?
episode.recap: At 3 a.m. something knocked on your fourth-floor window, then on your bedroom door, and spoke in your mom's voice.
episode.caption: you live on the fourth floor. what would you do?

shots.say: Imagine you wake up at three a.m. to a knock on your window.
You live on the fourth floor.
Your phone lights up. No caller ID.
Iro, the AI in your pocket, whispers: there are two heartbeats in this room.
Then the knocking moves. Now it's at your bedroom door.
A green light spills under it.
A voice that sounds exactly like your mom says: open up. It's me.
But your mom is asleep down the hall.
Do you open the door, or hide?

stories.name: Lights out
stories.premise: Every light in your city goes out in the same second. Your phone has four percent left and one new message from an unknown number: do not look outside.

stories.name: After hours
stories.premise: You stayed late at the office. The building has locked itself, and the elevator keeps opening on your floor with nobody inside.

stories.name: Two came back
stories.premise: You and your best friend are in the forest at night. Your friend walks off to check a noise. Ten minutes later, two of them walk back.
